trajectory_summary: This is a short, honest call: the rep correctly identifies that the lead isn't buildable today (no structure, no roof design, and Ion doesn't do ground mounts) and says so plainly instead of stringing the customer along. But the ending is where the call actually gets interesting — the customer keeps volunteering fresh, qualified interest (net metering under his co-op, battery banks) right as the rep is trying to sign off, and that energy is caught only passively. The call closes on a personal-phone-number handoff rather than any structured or confirmed follow-up.
outcome_dispute: A DQ read (no structure built, no roof to design against) is plausible and likely correct given Ion's stated constraints. But the ending shows real, self-generated re-engagement from the customer (net metering question, battery bank interest) that goes underused — worth flagging so this isn't filed as a dead lead without a documented, trackable next step.
